Vergrim's Protective Headgear of the Goshly Wisker
Piece:  Helm
Class:  Fighter
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

Vergrim's Protective Headgear of the Goshly Wisker is a fighter plate.

This rainbow is specific to Vergrim's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Agility
  • + Strength
  • + Ice Damage Resistance
  • + Poison Damage Resistance
  • + Shadow Damage Resistance
  • + % Melee Attack Speed
  • + % Movement Speed
  • + Defense Rating
  • + Melee Attack Rating

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
